title: Corner-Three Relocate Shooting
description: Shooters start at the wing, relocate to the corner as the ball is reversed, and catch-and-shoot — the exact footwork good shooters use off a skip pass.

content.objective: Relocate on the pass and be ready to shoot the instant the ball arrives in the corner.
content.setup: Shooter starts at the wing; a passer stands at the top of the key.
instructions: As the passer begins to reverse the ball, the shooter slides to the corner.
The passer delivers a skip pass to the corner the moment the shooter is set.
The shooter catches already squared and shoots immediately.
Reset to the wing and repeat, alternating sides.
coachingPoints: Relocate before the ball arrives, not after.
Keep the feet moving into a square landing, not a sideways shuffle.
Call for the ball once set, not while still moving.
commonMistakes: Arriving in the corner still off-balance when the pass comes.
Standing in the corner the whole time instead of relocating live.
Rushing the release instead of trusting the mechanics.
content.safety: Keep the baseline area clear for the shooter's footwork.
